complete_app_archive.temporary_extraction_cleanup: enforced and checked on context exit

isolation: complete app/ tree from fixed read-only git archive; temporary SQLite; in-memory Flask limiter; no current working-tree legacy import or persistent data

catalog_primitive_contract.candidate_order: question id ascending for evidence only; HTTP returns a scalar count
catalog_primitive_contract.anonymous: unlocked or NULL-lock subjects, including NULL subject_id
catalog_primitive_contract.authenticated: same lock rule plus actor-accessible subject IDs; NULL subject_id excluded
catalog_primitive_contract.subject: exact name match; only exact lowercase all disables the filter
catalog_primitive_contract.type: only exact lowercase all disables the filter; otherwise legacy portable conversion applies

future_learning_composition.rule: intersect catalog candidate IDs with actor-owned source and tag IDs
future_learning_composition.route_auth_difference: anonymous alias is public except mode favorites/mistakes; blueprint requires session or valid JWT

legacy_tag_fallback_observation.intended_path: read user_progress and lazily populate user_question_tag_items
legacy_tag_fallback_observation.captured_fixed_stack_result: both routes return count 0; idempotent tag DDL is attempted; migration DML is not reached
legacy_tag_fallback_observation.reason: the legacy row['data'] access is caught by the fixed SQLAlchemy stack and becomes an empty store
legacy_tag_fallback_observation.future_requirement: do not treat this capture as positive lazy-migration evidence; learning must decide and test the intended old-store compatibility explicitly

legacy_get_side_effect_facts.response_cache: GET reads/initializes version keys and attempts a TTL response-cache write
legacy_get_side_effect_facts.rate_limit: the shared 60/minute;600/hour wrapper consumes endpoint-scoped runtime state after global auth
legacy_get_side_effect_facts.tag_read: GET executes idempotent tag-table DDL; the fixed-stack legacy user_progress row reader does not reach migration DML in the captured fallback cases
legacy_get_side_effect_facts.transaction: the handler has no explicit commit; every case records post-rollback table fingerprints
legacy_get_side_effect_facts.session: the Session-only precedence case primes the in-memory last_active throttle before capture; the mixed Session+Bearer case follows the valid-Bearer global-auth branch

redaction: synthetic identities only; JWT values omitted; fixed request ID
